Fetch renmods data for specific ems_ids

Source: R/fetch.R
fetch_renmods.Rd

Light wrapper around renmods::renmods_connect() to fetch data by date and EMS ID. Also collects data into memory, so can take some time if a lot of data are requested.

Usage

fetch_renmods(ems_ids, date_range)

Arguments

ems_ids

Character Vector. EMS ids to filter EnMoDS samples to.

date_range

Character/Date Vector. Start/end dates to filter to. NULL returns all data.

Value

Data frame of filtered EnMoDS data.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
s <- fetch_renmods(
  ems_ids = c("1401030", "1401377"),
  date_range = c("2020-01-01", "2022-02-01")
)
}
